source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 3 同主题完形(少年独自环球航行/世界海洋日/深海工作者/海豹传说/北极科考/海上丝路合作)。用词限本单元/高中常见词,答案唯一,选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: The Youngest Sailor
passages.text: In 2008, a sixteen-year-old boy set (1)____ on an amazing journey: to sail alone around the whole world. As a child, he had read a (2)____ about another young sailor and dreamed of doing the same. Using his own money, he bought a boat and (3)____ off. The voyage was a (4)____ of danger and boredom. He had to fight through heavy storms and get by on very little (5)____. To pass the time, he read many books and (6)____ his family every evening using a small laptop. After thirteen long months, he returned home with a new world (7)____ as the youngest person ever to sail around the world alone. His adventure received wide media (8)____ everywhere. At his press conference, he said that passion and (9)____ had made his dream come true. In his opinion, there is so much that people can (10)____ if they simply go for it.

questions.explanation: emailed his family 给家人发邮件。
a world record 世界纪录。
passion and courage 激情与勇气。

passages.title: World Oceans Day
passages.text: World Oceans Day takes (1)____ on the eighth of June every year. It is now celebrated in over a hundred (2)____, with hundreds of special events held across the globe. The day is (3)____ in many ways, including new campaigns and special programmes, all working to (4)____ ocean conservation and education. Young people are an important (5)____ of the project, because the future of the sea belongs to them. The day gives them a platform (6)____ they can share ideas and express their concerns. Each year there is a different (7)____ for the events, such as 'Our oceans, our future'. Schools often ask students to clean a (8)____, watch a film about marine life, or listen to talks by sea (9)____. Through such activities, more and more people come to (10)____ how precious and how fragile the ocean really is.

questions.explanation: over a hundred countries 一百多个国家。
an important part 重要部分。
a platform where 地点关系副词。
clean a beach 清理海滩。

passages.title: Working in the Deep
passages.text: Few jobs are as exciting or as difficult as exploring the deep sea. The ocean floor is so dark and so cold that humans cannot go there without a special (1)____. Engineers must (2)____ machines that can stand huge pressure far below the surface. A manned (3)____ may carry only two or three people, so every member of the team must be calm and well (4)____. Before each dive, the crew (5)____ every detail of the journey, because a tiny mistake underwater could be (6)____. Once at the bottom, they use powerful lights and cameras to (7)____ creatures that no human eye has ever seen. They also collect rare (8)____ from the sea floor to bring back for study. Their work has greatly (9)____ our knowledge of marine life. Though the deep sea remains a dangerous place, these brave workers believe it is a (10)____ well worth the risk.

questions.explanation: plans every detail 规划每个细节。
could be deadly 可能致命。
extended our knowledge 拓展知识。

passages.title: The Boy from the Sea
passages.text: An old story tells of an old couple who lived by the sea. One day they heard a baby (1)____ near the water, and when they hurried over, they found a baby seal instead. They took it home, fed it, and (2)____ it as their own son. Gradually the seal grew up (3)____ just like a human boy. The couple loved him deeply and allowed him to go (4)____ except near the sea, for they were (5)____ of losing him. The boy loved his parents so much that he (6)____ never to swim. One day the father went fishing, (7)____ the weather suddenly changed. As the ship rolled in the wild waves, the mother watched the horrible (8)____ helplessly. All of a sudden, the son jumped into the stormy sea (9)____ his father. Swimming as fast as lightning, he pushed the old man safely back to the (10)____, but the couple never saw their brave son again.

questions.explanation: heard a baby cry 听到婴儿哭。
现在分词作伴随状语 looking。
afraid of losing 害怕失去。
promised never to swim 承诺绝不游泳。
..., when 突然(并列时间)→ when。
the horrible scene 可怕的景象。
to save 表目的的不定式。
back to the shore 回到岸边。

passages.title: Studying the Arctic
passages.text: In recent years, China has joined other nations on several (1)____ to explore the far north. From a scientific point of (2)____, there is an urgent need to study the Arctic in order to understand climate (3)____ and its effects. Because of warming, there is less ice now, (4)____ means ships can travel further north than before. Scientists worry that if we (5)____ more fossil fuels, the ice will melt even faster, and this negative (6)____ will continue. On these expeditions, researchers (7)____ the temperature of the water, the thickness of the ice and the movements of (8)____ animals such as seals and whales. The data they collect helps the whole world (9)____ how quickly our planet is changing. Studying the Arctic is hard and dangerous work, but most scientists agree that it is absolutely (10)____ for our shared future.

questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指代整句、作主语 → which。
burn fossil fuels 燃烧化石燃料。

passages.title: Friends Across the Sea
passages.text: China has long wished to (1)____ out across the sea and build friendly bonds with the rest of the world. One modern plan aims to encourage cooperation and (2)____ along the historic Silk Road areas. Trade has grown greatly in recent years and is likely to (3)____ to grow in years to come. China has (4)____ billions in systems and services along these routes, (5)____ will help develop the whole area for future trade and cultural (6)____. China has also joined its friends across the sea on other important (7)____, such as studying the Arctic together. Hundreds of years ago, (8)____ like Zheng He sailed these waters to trade in silk and spices. Today, with the latest technology in (9)____, the need to trade and the desire to (10)____ relationships still drive China far out across the sea.

questions.explanation: reach out 伸出(友谊之手)。
cooperation and trade 合作与贸易。
continue to grow 继续增长。
非限制性定语从句指物、作主语 → which。
explorers like Zheng He 像郑和这样的探险家。
